reason: The first V5.330 real Windows Product proof reached a genuine backend runtime RED after Element host, source clone, secret guard, dependency materialization and backend readiness were all GREEN. DesktopHost received backend-process-ready-owner-untrusted, then its pre-trust bootstrap Runtime API request timed out with TRANSPORT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and containment correctly terminated the untrusted backend. Fresh source closure in Controller V5.331 proved this is a distinct backend readiness-order root: backend/server.js announces backend:ready before all same-thread post-ready account/AI recovery work is prevented from racing the first /api/desktop/runtime-projection-snapshot. The V20 Product six-file candidate is frozen and out of this root. This prerequisite authorizes only the mature backend startup owner and the existing production-runtime regression seams needed to guarantee that the first bootstrap control-plane response completes before deferred enhancement recovery can consume the event loop.

rootCause.directEvidence: Frozen V5.330 Windows evidence records backend:ready GREEN with credential hydration complete, followed by backend-process-ready-owner-untrusted and a real ApiV2RuntimeClient timeout before owner acceptance. The user-visible terminal projection is '言策启动失败 / Runtime API request timed out / TRANSPORT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN'. Source closure proves this reason code originates from ApiV2RuntimeClient HTTP transport, not fd6. backend/server.js publishes ready and then still performs synchronous account projection and schedules AI recovery work which can run before the loopback bootstrap request is serviced.
rootCause.requiredRepair: Keep the existing /api/desktop/runtime-projection-snapshot, API-session security, ApiV2RuntimeClient timeout, RuntimeProjectionCoordinator validation and DesktopCredentialApplicationCoordinator containment contracts unchanged. In backend/server.js, ensure no synchronous post-ready account or AI recovery workload can run ahead of the first pre-trust bootstrap snapshot response. Reuse the existing bootstrap endpoint as the control-plane boundary and defer enhancement startup until that response has finished; eliminate or move the redundant post-ready account summary so ready does not precede blocking Product projection work. The fix must be idempotent and must not introduce another readiness state machine, transport, retry loop or owner authority.
